_sections.blurb: Run name, input images, output location, and resume behavior.

_sections.label: Compute & Hardware
_sections.blurb: Which devices LM3 may use, how many workers fit in VRAM, and the ONNX Runtime providers.

_sections.label: Image Preparation
_sections.blurb: How originals are downscaled and re-encoded into the working copies every module reads.

_sections.label: File Naming
_sections.blurb: The prefixes and friendly class names baked into every exported filename.

_sections.label: Timing
_sections.blurb: The per-module run-timing profiler and its report.

_sections.label: MP Conversion Factor
_sections.blurb: Predicts a conversion factor from image resolution alone, as the fallback when no ruler is usable.

_sections.label: Archival Detector
_sections.blurb: Finds the non-plant items on the sheet: rulers, barcodes, color cards, labels, maps, envelopes.

_sections.label: Plant Detector
_sections.blurb: Finds plant organs: whole and partial leaves, leaflets, fruits, flowers, buds, roots, wood.

_sections.label: Specimen Segmenter
_sections.blurb: Whole-sheet plant-versus-background mask, with optional paper cleanup.

_sections.label: Phenology Detector
_sections.blurb: Reads the plant boxes to decide whether leaves, flowers and fruits are present.

_sections.label: Ruler Classifier
_sections.blurb: Classifies each ruler crop by unit type, the first half of measuring the conversion factor.

_sections.label: Ruler Conversion Factor
_sections.blurb: Measures pixels per centimeter from the ruler's tick lattice.

_sections.label: Leaf Segmenter
_sections.blurb: Turns each leaf crop into an instance mask for lamina, petiole and holes.

_sections.label: Morphology
_sections.blurb: Shape metrics and the rotated minimum bounding box for every leaf mask.

_sections.label: Landmark Detector
_sections.blurb: The 31-keypoint leaf pose: midvein, lamina outline, apex, base and petiole.

_sections.label: Landmark Measurements
_sections.blurb: Traces, extent, width, apex and base angles, and curvature, derived from the keypoints.

_sections.label: Leaf Orientation
_sections.blurb: The upright rotation that puts every leaf tip up.

_sections.label: Petiole Width
_sections.blurb: Median perpendicular width of the petiole, from its mask and landmark centerline.

_sections.label: Bilateral Symmetry
_sections.blurb: Scores how closely each leaf mirrors itself across the midvein.

_sections.label: Shape (ECT)
_sections.blurb: Euler Characteristic Transform of each oriented leaf, plus its visuals.

_sections.label: Metric Grounding
_sections.blurb: Converts every pixel measurement to real units using the conversion factor.

_sections.label: Reporter
_sections.blurb: Every file LM3 writes: crops, masks, per-leaf products, and the annotated review overlays.

version.label: Settings version
version.help: Schema version of this settings file; LM3 3.x expects 3.

project.run_name.label: Run name
project.run_name.help: Names this run's output folder (<output dir>/<run name>/) and its project database.

project.input.dirs.label: Input folders
project.input.dirs.help: One or more folders of original specimen images to process.

project.input.recursive.label: Search subfolders
project.input.recursive.help: Also collect images from every folder nested inside the input folders.

project.input.image_extensions.label: Image extensions
project.input.image_extensions.help: Only files with these extensions are collected as input images.

project.output.dir.label: Output folder
project.output.dir.help: Parent folder that receives <run name>/ with the database, crops, reports, and logs.

project.output.tmp_dir.label: Temp file location
project.output.tmp_dir.help: Where the RGB-converted / downscaled working copies go; 'auto' keeps them inside the run folder, or give a path on a fast, roomy disk.

project.run_mode.overwrite.label: Overwrite existing run
project.run_mode.overwrite.help: Discard any previous results for this run name and start from scratch.

project.run_mode.restart.label: Restart modules
project.run_mode.restart.help: Empty resumes where the last run stopped; 'all' redoes everything; or list the module keys to redo (for example leaf_segmenter).

project.run_mode.fail_fast.label: Stop on first error
project.run_mode.fail_fast.help: Abort the whole run the moment any image fails instead of logging it and continuing.

project.logging.level.label: Log level
project.logging.level.help: Lowest severity written to the log; DEBUG is very chatty.

project.logging.to_file.label: Write log file
project.logging.to_file.help: Save the run log to <run>/logs/ in addition to any console output.

project.logging.to_console.label: Log to console
project.logging.to_console.help: Stream log lines to the console, which is what feeds the live log view.

compute.devices.label: Devices
compute.devices.help: 'auto' uses every visible NVIDIA GPU (CPU only if there is none), 'cpu' forces CPU, or give explicit GPU ordinals such as [0, 1].

compute.tensorrt.label: Use TensorRT
compute.tensorrt.help: Try the TensorRT execution provider for ONNX models; falls back to CUDA when unavailable.

compute.mock.label: Mock models
compute.mock.help: Replace every model with a deterministic synthetic stand-in so a run can be exercised with no weights and no GPU.

compute.longest_first.label: Longest-first dispatch
compute.longest_first.help: Dispatch the largest work items first so a stage does not end waiting on one huge sheet; off keeps the raw specimen order.

compute.precision.label: Precision
compute.precision.help: Numeric precision for GPU inference; fp16 is roughly twice as fast, fp32 is the safe fallback.

compute.io_workers.label: I/O workers
compute.io_workers.help: Threads used for image ingest and the CPU-only modules; 'auto' leaves two cores free.

compute.force_reprobe.label: Force VRAM reprobe
compute.force_reprobe.help: Live-probe VRAM at startup even when a tuned hardware profile already exists.

compute.vram.safety_fraction.label: VRAM safety fraction
compute.vram.safety_fraction.help: Fraction of each GPU's free memory LM3 is allowed to plan against.

compute.vram.reserve_mb.label: VRAM reserve (MB)
compute.vram.reserve_mb.help: Megabytes held back on every GPU for the driver and other processes.

compute.vram.per_worker_mb.label: VRAM per worker (MB)
compute.vram.per_worker_mb.help: Fixed per-worker VRAM budget; 'auto' uses the measured peak from the hardware profile.

compute.vram.max_workers_per_gpu.label: Max workers per GPU
compute.vram.max_workers_per_gpu.help: Hard ceiling on concurrent model workers placed on a single GPU.

compute.vram.headroom_factor.label: VRAM headroom factor
compute.vram.headroom_factor.help: Multiplier on the measured per-worker VRAM cost when placing workers; higher is safer but fits fewer workers per GPU.

compute.vram.concurrent_warm_loads.label: Concurrent warm loads
compute.vram.concurrent_warm_loads.help: How many workers may load their model at once; lower values shrink the startup VRAM spike but lengthen pool ramp-up.

compute.workers.default.label: Default workers
compute.workers.default.help: Worker count for any module without its own override; 'auto' derives it from the hardware profile.

compute.workers.ruler_cf.label: Ruler CF workers
compute.workers.ruler_cf.help: Worker count for the pure-CPU ruler lattice conversion-factor module.

compute.onnxruntime.providers.label: ONNX providers
compute.onnxruntime.providers.help: Execution providers to offer onnxruntime in order; 'auto' picks CUDA then CPU.

compute.onnxruntime.ld_library_path.label: CUDA library path
compute.onnxruntime.ld_library_path.help: Extra LD_LIBRARY_PATH entries so onnxruntime can find the CUDA libraries; 'auto' resolves them from the installed torch wheels.

compute.onnxruntime.allow_cpu_fallback.label: Allow CPU fallback
compute.onnxruntime.allow_cpu_fallback.help: Let onnxruntime silently drop to the CPU provider instead of failing when CUDA will not load.

ingest.max_working_dim.label: Max working dimension
ingest.max_working_dim.help: Long-side pixel cap for the working copy every module sees; larger originals are downscaled once at ingest.

ingest.jpg_quality.label: Working JPEG quality
ingest.jpg_quality.help: JPEG quality of the converted working copies, 100 being visually lossless.

naming.bbox_prefix.label: Bounding-box prefix
naming.bbox_prefix.help: Filename tag used for detection bounding-box crops.

naming.seg_prefix.label: Segmentation prefix
naming.seg_prefix.help: Filename tag used for per-crop segmentation masks.

naming.seg_rgb_prefix.label: Segmentation RGB prefix
naming.seg_rgb_prefix.help: Filename tag used for per-crop RGB cutouts. Must differ from the segmentation prefix: the cutout and its binary mask describe the same class and box, so a shared tag would leave only the file extension to tell them apart.

naming.mask_full_prefix.label: Full-mask prefix
naming.mask_full_prefix.help: Filename tag used for full-image masks.

naming.mask_rgb_full_prefix.label: Full-mask RGB prefix
naming.mask_rgb_full_prefix.help: Filename tag used for full-image RGB cutouts. Must differ from the full-mask prefix, for the same reason as the segmentation pair.

naming.landmark_prefix.label: Landmark prefix
naming.landmark_prefix.help: Filename tag used for per-leaf landmark overlays.

naming.petiole_prefix.label: Petiole prefix
naming.petiole_prefix.help: Filename tag used for per-leaf petiole overlays.

naming.bilateral_prefix.label: Bilateral-symmetry prefix
naming.bilateral_prefix.help: Filename tag used for per-leaf bilateral-symmetry QC panels.

naming.friendly_names.Ruler.label: Ruler
naming.friendly_names.Ruler.help: Short name written into every Ruler filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Barcode.label: Barcode
naming.friendly_names.Barcode.help: Short name written into every Barcode filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Colorcard.label: Color card
naming.friendly_names.Colorcard.help: Short name written into every Colorcard filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Label.label: Label
naming.friendly_names.Label.help: Short name written into every Label filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Map.label: Map
naming.friendly_names.Map.help: Short name written into every Map filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Envelope.label: Envelope
naming.friendly_names.Envelope.help: Short name written into every Envelope filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Photo.label: Photo
naming.friendly_names.Photo.help: Short name written into every Photo filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Attached_Item.label: Attached item
naming.friendly_names.Attached_Item.help: Short name written into every Attached_Item filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Weights.label: Weights
naming.friendly_names.Weights.help: Short name written into every Weights filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Leaf_WHOLE.label: Whole leaf
naming.friendly_names.Leaf_WHOLE.help: Short name written into every Leaf_WHOLE filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Leaf_PARTIAL.label: Partial leaf
naming.friendly_names.Leaf_PARTIAL.help: Short name written into every Leaf_PARTIAL filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Leaflet.label: Leaflet
naming.friendly_names.Leaflet.help: Short name written into every Leaflet filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Seed_Fruit_ONE.label: Single fruit
naming.friendly_names.Seed_Fruit_ONE.help: Short name written into every Seed_Fruit_ONE filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Seed_Fruit_MANY.label: Fruit cluster
naming.friendly_names.Seed_Fruit_MANY.help: Short name written into every Seed_Fruit_MANY filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Flower_ONE.label: Single flower
naming.friendly_names.Flower_ONE.help: Short name written into every Flower_ONE filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Flower_MANY.label: Flower cluster
naming.friendly_names.Flower_MANY.help: Short name written into every Flower_MANY filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Bud.label: Bud
naming.friendly_names.Bud.help: Short name written into every Bud filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Specimen.label: Specimen
naming.friendly_names.Specimen.help: Short name written into every Specimen filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Specimen_Inverse.label: Not-specimen
naming.friendly_names.Specimen_Inverse.help: Short name written into every not-specimen mask filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Roots.label: Roots
naming.friendly_names.Roots.help: Short name written into every Roots filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Wood.label: Wood
naming.friendly_names.Wood.help: Short name written into every Wood filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Leaf.label: Leaf (mask)
naming.friendly_names.Leaf.help: Short name written into every Leaf filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Petiole.label: Petiole (mask)
naming.friendly_names.Petiole.help: Short name written into every Petiole filename and its export folder name.

naming.friendly_names.Hole.label: Hole (mask)
naming.friendly_names.Hole.help: Short name written into every Hole filename and its export folder name.

modules.mp_conversion_factor.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.mp_conversion_factor.enabled.help: Predict a rough conversion factor from image resolution alone; it runs first and anchors the ruler measurements.

modules.mp_conversion_factor.model.path.label: Model file
modules.mp_conversion_factor.model.path.help: Path to the exported Megapixel CF weights, relative to the LM3 install or absolute.

modules.mp_conversion_factor.model.forma.label: Model format
modules.mp_conversion_factor.model.forma.help: Artifact kind at that path; it must match the file you pointed at.

modules.archival_detector.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.archival_detector.enabled.help: Detect the non-plant items on the sheet: rulers, labels, barcodes, color cards, and more.

modules.archival_detector.model.path.label: Model file
modules.archival_detector.model.path.help: Path to the exported Archival Detector weights, relative to the LM3 install or absolute.

modules.archival_detector.model.format.label: Model format
modules.archival_detector.model.format.help: Artifact kind at that path; it must match the file you pointed at.

modules.archival_detector.imgsz.label: Image size
modules.archival_detector.imgsz.help: Square input size the detector letterboxes each sheet into; larger sees smaller items but costs more time and VRAM.

modules.archival_detector.conf.label: Confidence threshold
modules.archival_detector.conf.help: Minimum score a detection needs to be kept.

modules.archival_detector.iou.label: IOU threshold
modules.archival_detector.iou.help: Overlap threshold used when merging competing boxes.

modules.archival_detector.max_det.label: Max detections
modules.archival_detector.max_det.help: Ceiling on boxes kept per sheet.

modules.archival_detector.min_box_area.label: Min box area (px)
modules.archival_detector.min_box_area.help: Boxes smaller than this many pixels of area are discarded as noise.

modules.archival_detector.classes.label: Class names
modules.archival_detector.classes.help: Class list in the exported model's own order; edit only when you swap in a model trained on a different set.

modules.archival_detector.dedup.enabled.label: Remove duplicate boxes
modules.archival_detector.dedup.enabled.help: Reject the lower-confidence box of any same-class overlapping pair, since the detector is NMS-free and can emit duplicates.

modules.archival_detector.dedup.overlap.label: Duplicate overlap
modules.archival_detector.dedup.overlap.help: Overlap at or above which two same-class boxes count as duplicates.

modules.archival_detector.dedup.metric.label: Duplicate metric
modules.archival_detector.dedup.metric.help: 'min' measures intersection over the smaller box, which catches nested duplicates; 'iou' is the standard intersection over union.

modules.plant_detector.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.plant_detector.enabled.help: Detect the plant organs on the sheet: leaves, flowers, fruits, buds, roots, and wood.

modules.plant_detector.model.path.label: Model file
modules.plant_detector.model.path.help: Path to the exported Plant Detector weights, relative to the LM3 install or absolute.

modules.plant_detector.model.format.label: Model format
modules.plant_detector.model.format.help: Artifact kind at that path; it must match the file you pointed at.

modules.plant_detector.imgsz.label: Image size
modules.plant_detector.imgsz.help: Square input size the detector letterboxes each sheet into; larger finds smaller organs but costs more time and VRAM.

modules.plant_detector.conf.label: Confidence threshold
modules.plant_detector.conf.help: Minimum score an organ detection needs to be kept.

modules.plant_detector.iou.label: IOU threshold
modules.plant_detector.iou.help: Overlap threshold used when merging competing boxes.

modules.plant_detector.max_det.label: Max detections
modules.plant_detector.max_det.help: Ceiling on organ boxes kept per sheet; dense sheets need a high value.

modules.plant_detector.min_box_area.label: Min box area (px)
modules.plant_detector.min_box_area.help: Organ boxes smaller than this many pixels of area are discarded as noise.

modules.plant_detector.classes.label: Class names
modules.plant_detector.classes.help: Class list in the exported model's own order; edit only when you swap in a model trained on a different set.

modules.plant_detector.dedup.enabled.label: Remove duplicate boxes
modules.plant_detector.dedup.enabled.help: Reject the lower-confidence box of any same-class overlapping pair, since the detector is NMS-free and can emit duplicates.

modules.plant_detector.dedup.overlap.label: Duplicate overlap
modules.plant_detector.dedup.overlap.help: Overlap at or above which two same-class boxes count as duplicates.

modules.plant_detector.dedup.metric.label: Duplicate metric
modules.plant_detector.dedup.metric.help: 'min' measures intersection over the smaller box, which catches nested duplicates; 'iou' is the standard intersection over union.

modules.specimen_segmenter.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.specimen_segmenter.enabled.help: Cut the whole plant away from the sheet background as one binary mask.

modules.specimen_segmenter.model.key.label: Model
modules.specimen_segmenter.model.key.help: Which specimen segmenter this is: unetpp_effb7_1024 (UNet++, default), birefnet_hr_swinl_1024 (BiRefNet), yolo26x_seg_1280 (YOLO26x-seg). The name picks how the sheet is prepared for the model, so it must match the file below.

modules.specimen_segmenter.model.path.label: Model file
modules.specimen_segmenter.model.path.help: Path to the exported Specimen Segmenter weights (the file for the Model chosen above), relative to the LM3 install or absolute.

modules.specimen_segmenter.model.format.label: Model format
modules.specimen_segmenter.model.format.help: Artifact kind at that path; it must match the file you pointed at (the UNet++ export is ONNX).

modules.specimen_segmenter.imgsz.label: Image size (retired)
modules.specimen_segmenter.imgsz.help: No longer used: each model runs at the size it was trained at (UNet++ and BiRefNet 1024, YOLO26x-seg 1280). A different value here is ignored with a warning.

modules.specimen_segmenter.conf.label: Mask threshold
modules.specimen_segmenter.conf.help: Probability above which a pixel becomes plant in the binary mask (UNet++ and BiRefNet). YOLO26x-seg uses its own confidence below.

modules.specimen_segmenter.yolo.conf.label: YOLO instance confidence
modules.specimen_segmenter.yolo.conf.help: YOLO26x-seg only: keep plant instances at or above this confidence; their masks are joined into the specimen mask.

modules.specimen_segmenter.yolo.iou.label: YOLO IoU
modules.specimen_segmenter.yolo.iou.help: YOLO26x-seg only: overlap setting passed to the model (end-to-end exports do no separate suppression, so this rarely matters).

modules.specimen_segmenter.yolo.max_det.label: YOLO max instances
modules.specimen_segmenter.yolo.max_det.help: YOLO26x-seg only: most plant instances kept per sheet.

modules.specimen_segmenter.paperclean.label: Paper cleanup
modules.specimen_segmenter.paperclean.help: Run the follow-up color pass that strips leftover paper the network kept.

modules.phenology_detector.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.phenology_detector.enabled.help: Roll the plant detections up into per-specimen leaf, flower, and fruit presence flags.

modules.phenology_detector.targets.leave.label: Leaves: min confidence
modules.phenology_detector.targets.leave.help: Detections below this score do not count toward leaves being present.

modules.phenology_detector.targets.leave.label: Leaves: min count
modules.phenology_detector.targets.leave.help: How many qualifying detections a specimen needs before leaves are called present.

modules.phenology_detector.targets.flowe.label: Flowers: min confidence
modules.phenology_detector.targets.flowe.help: Detections below this score do not count toward flowers being present.

modules.phenology_detector.targets.flowe.label: Flowers: min count
modules.phenology_detector.targets.flowe.help: How many qualifying detections a specimen needs before flowers are called present.

modules.phenology_detector.targets.fruit.label: Fruits: min confidence
modules.phenology_detector.targets.fruit.help: Detections below this score do not count toward fruits being present.

modules.phenology_detector.targets.fruit.label: Fruits: min count
modules.phenology_detector.targets.fruit.help: How many qualifying detections a specimen needs before fruits are called present.

modules.ruler_classifier.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.ruler_classifier.enabled.help: Identify each detected ruler's unit type with a three-model ensemble.

modules.ruler_classifier.models_dir.label: Models folder
modules.ruler_classifier.models_dir.help: Folder holding the exported ensemble members.

modules.ruler_classifier.ensemble_member.label: Ensemble members
modules.ruler_classifier.ensemble_member.help: Which exported members to load and vote across.

modules.ruler_classifier.min_conf.label: Min confidence
modules.ruler_classifier.min_conf.help: Ensemble agreement a ruler needs before its unit type is trusted downstream.

modules.ruler_classifier.squarify.sz.label: Squarify tile size
modules.ruler_classifier.squarify.sz.help: Tile edge in pixels for the collage that turns a long ruler strip into a square input; tile_four makes a collage twice this wide.

modules.ruler_classifier.squarify.method.label: Squarify method
modules.ruler_classifier.squarify.method.help: How the ruler strip is cut and stacked into a square; tile_four is what all three members were trained on.

modules.ruler_cf.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.ruler_cf.enabled.help: Measure every ruler's tick lattice and fuse them into one gated conversion factor for the sheet.

modules.ruler_cf.anchor_tol.label: Anchor tolerance
modules.ruler_cf.anchor_tol.help: How far a lattice reading may drift from the megapixel-predicted conversion factor before it is rejected, as a fraction.

modules.ruler_cf.min_frame_cm.label: Min frame width (cm)
modules.ruler_cf.min_frame_cm.help: Sanity floor on how small the sheet can be in centimeters; leave empty for the engine's own 20 cm default.

modules.leaf_segmenter.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.leaf_segmenter.enabled.help: Trace the lamina, petiole, and holes inside every leaf crop.

modules.leaf_segmenter.model.path.label: Model file
modules.leaf_segmenter.model.path.help: Path to the exported Leaf Segmenter weights, relative to the LM3 install or absolute.

modules.leaf_segmenter.model.format.label: Model format
modules.leaf_segmenter.model.format.help: Artifact kind at that path; it must match the file you pointed at (PyTorch today, ONNX once exported).

modules.leaf_segmenter.include_partial.label: Include partial leaves
modules.leaf_segmenter.include_partial.help: Also segment Leaf_PARTIAL crops, which are cut off by the sheet edge or another organ.

modules.leaf_segmenter.imgsz.label: Image size
modules.leaf_segmenter.imgsz.help: Square input size for each leaf crop; larger gives finer mask edges at more cost.

modules.leaf_segmenter.conf.label: Confidence threshold
modules.leaf_segmenter.conf.help: Minimum score a mask instance needs to be kept.

modules.leaf_segmenter.iou.label: IOU threshold
modules.leaf_segmenter.iou.help: Overlap threshold used when merging competing mask instances.

modules.leaf_segmenter.retina_masks.label: High-resolution masks
modules.leaf_segmenter.retina_masks.help: Produce masks at the crop's own resolution instead of the model's coarser grid.

modules.leaf_segmenter.max_det.label: Max instances
modules.leaf_segmenter.max_det.help: Ceiling on mask instances kept per leaf crop.

modules.leaf_segmenter.mask_storage.form.label: Mask storage
modules.leaf_segmenter.mask_storage.form.help: How masks are stored in the project database; polygon_xy needs no extra dependencies.

modules.leaf_segmenter.mask_storage.min_.label: Min mask area (px)
modules.leaf_segmenter.mask_storage.min_.help: Mask instances smaller than this many pixels are dropped as specks.

modules.morphology.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.morphology.enabled.help: Measure area, perimeter, and the rotated bounding box of each segmented mask.

modules.morphology.method.label: Rotated-box method
modules.morphology.method.help: Algorithm that finds each leaf's long axis; pca is the area-weighted principal axis and is the most robust across leaf shapes.

modules.morphology.find_minimum_bounding.label: Rotate to minimum box
modules.morphology.find_minimum_bounding.help: Only used by the lm2 method: run its rotate-to-minimum-circle search.

modules.landmark_detector.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.landmark_detector.enabled.help: Place the 31-keypoint leaf skeleton (midvein, apex, base, width, petiole) on each leaf crop.

modules.landmark_detector.model.path.label: Model file
modules.landmark_detector.model.path.help: Path to the exported Landmark Detector weights, relative to the LM3 install or absolute.

modules.landmark_detector.model.format.label: Model format
modules.landmark_detector.model.format.help: Artifact kind at that path; it must match the file you pointed at.

modules.landmark_detector.include_partia.label: Include partial leaves
modules.landmark_detector.include_partia.help: Also landmark Leaf_PARTIAL crops, whose missing tip or base makes the keypoints less reliable.

modules.landmark_detector.imgsz.label: Image size
modules.landmark_detector.imgsz.help: Square input size for each leaf crop fed to the pose model.

modules.landmark_detector.conf.label: Confidence threshold
modules.landmark_detector.conf.help: Minimum score a landmark detection needs to be kept.

modules.landmark_detector.iou.label: IOU threshold
modules.landmark_detector.iou.help: Overlap threshold used when merging competing pose detections.

modules.landmark_detector.white_pad.label: White padding
modules.landmark_detector.white_pad.help: White border added before inference and removed after, matching how the model was trained.

modules.landmark_measurements.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.landmark_measurements.enabled.help: Derive lamina length, width, apex and base angles, and curvature from the keypoints.

modules.landmark_measurements.min_kpt_co.label: Min keypoint confidence
modules.landmark_measurements.min_kpt_co.help: Keypoints below this score are treated as absent and the metrics that need them stay empty.

modules.leaf_orientation.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.leaf_orientation.enabled.help: Find the rotation that stands each leaf upright with its tip up, which the oriented exports and the ECT depend on.

modules.leaf_orientation.min_kpt_conf.label: Min keypoint confidence
modules.leaf_orientation.min_kpt_conf.help: Keypoint score floor for the tip and base points that define the upright axis.

modules.leaf_orientation.min_midvein.label: Min midvein points
modules.leaf_orientation.min_midvein.help: How many midvein keypoints the principal-axis fallback needs when the tip or base is missing.

modules.petiole_width.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.petiole_width.enabled.help: Measure the median perpendicular width of each petiole mask.

modules.petiole_width.min_kpt_conf.label: Min keypoint confidence
modules.petiole_width.min_kpt_conf.help: Keypoint score floor for the petiole centerline points the width probes run along.

modules.petiole_width.touch_dist_px.label: Touch distance (px)
modules.petiole_width.touch_dist_px.help: How close a petiole mask must come to the lamina mask to count as attached.

modules.bilateral_symmetry.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.bilateral_symmetry.enabled.help: Score how well each oriented leaf mirrors about its traced midvein and flag the best-scoring ones as archetypal.

modules.bilateral_symmetry.min_kpt_conf.label: Min keypoint confidence
modules.bilateral_symmetry.min_kpt_conf.help: Keypoint score floor for the midvein, tip, and base points; lower-scoring keypoints are dropped before the axis is traced.

modules.bilateral_symmetry.n_bins.label: Max arclength bins
modules.bilateral_symmetry.n_bins.help: Upper bound on arclength bins along the midvein; small leaves get fewer bins so each one keeps about 500 lamina pixels.

modules.bilateral_symmetry.min_score.label: Min archetype score
modules.bilateral_symmetry.min_score.help: Archetype score a gate-passing leaf must reach to count as archetypal; raising it marks fewer leaves and draws more QC panels.

modules.bilateral_symmetry.qc_images.label: QC panels
modules.bilateral_symmetry.qc_images.help: Which leaves get a QC panel: none, flagged (failed a gate or below the score), or all, which adds about 0.12s per leaf.

modules.metric_grounding.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.metric_grounding.enabled.help: Convert the stored pixel measurements to centimeters using each sheet's conversion factor.

modules.metric_grounding.missing_cf_poli.label: Missing CF policy
modules.metric_grounding.missing_cf_poli.help: What to do for a specimen with no trusted conversion factor; skip leaves its centimeter columns empty and is the only implemented behavior.

modules.metric_grounding.round_ndigits.label: Rounding digits
modules.metric_grounding.round_ndigits.help: Decimal places kept on the converted centimeter values.

modules.reporter.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.reporter.enabled.help: Write the exported images: every overlay, mask, crop, and per-leaf product below comes from this module.

modules.ect.enabled.label: Enabled
modules.ect.enabled.help: Compute the Euler Characteristic Transform shape signature for each oriented whole leaf.

modules.ect.include_petiole.label: Include petiole
modules.ect.include_petiole.help: Add the petiole to the shape; leaving it off measures the lamina alone.

modules.ect.include_holes.label: Include holes
modules.ect.include_holes.help: Punch insect holes out of the lamina instead of filling them in.

modules.ect.num_dirs.label: Directions
modules.ect.num_dirs.help: How many angular directions (and thresholds) the transform sweeps; more gives a finer signature and a bigger file.

modules.ect.bound_radius.label: Bounding radius
modules.ect.bound_radius.help: Every outline is scaled to this unit-circle radius before the transform, so shapes are size-normalized.

modules.ect.palette.label: Color map
modules.ect.palette.help: Matplotlib color map used for both shape visuals.

modules.ect.apply_log_to_visual_for_bold.label: Bold colors (log scale the visuals)
modules.ect.apply_log_to_visual_for_bold.help: Log-scale the transform before coloring, so the color map spreads over the dense middle of the range and the structure stands out instead of washing into one shade. Affects the saved pictures only — the transform written to the data files and the database is always the raw, unscaled one.

modules.ect.radial_viz.label: Write radial visual
modules.ect.radial_viz.help: Save the polar view of each leaf's transform.

modules.ect.cartesian_viz.label: Write matrix visual
modules.ect.cartesian_viz.help: Save the rectangular matrix view of each leaf's transform.

modules.ect.radial_overlay_viz.label: Write outline overlay visual
modules.ect.radial_overlay_viz.help: Save the polar view with the leaf outline drawn on top, tip up in both.

modules.ect.outline_simple.label: Store simplified outline
modules.ect.outline_simple.help: Also keep a Douglas-Peucker-simplified copy of the outline in the data file.

modules.ect.simplify_tolerance.label: Simplify tolerance
modules.ect.simplify_tolerance.help: Douglas-Peucker distance tolerance on the size-normalized outline.

modules.ect.simplify_cutoff.label: Simplify cutoff
modules.ect.simplify_cutoff.help: Only outlines with more points than this get simplified.

modules.ect.export_literal_coords.label: Store pixel outline
modules.ect.export_literal_coords.help: Also keep the raw un-normalized pixel outline in the data file.

report.overlay.enabled.label: Write summary overlay
report.overlay.enabled.help: Save the annotated whole-sheet review image for every specimen.

report.overlay.box_style.label: Leaf box style
report.overlay.box_style.help: 'rotated' draws the minimum bounding box the Morphology module fitted; 'yolo' draws the axis-aligned detector box.

report.overlay.draw_masks.label: Draw masks
report.overlay.draw_masks.help: Fill the leaf, petiole, and hole masks on the overlay.

report.overlay.draw_landmarks.label: Draw landmarks
report.overlay.draw_landmarks.help: Draw the keypoints and skeleton on top of the masks and boxes.

report.overlay.draw_petiole.label: Draw petiole width
report.overlay.draw_petiole.help: Draw each measured petiole width as a colored band.

report.overlay.draw_labels.label: Draw class labels
report.overlay.draw_labels.help: Print the class name inside each box.

report.overlay.draw_confidence.label: Draw confidence
report.overlay.draw_confidence.help: Append the detection score to each class label.

report.overlay.draw_cf_banner.label: Draw CF banner
report.overlay.draw_cf_banner.help: Print the derived pixels-per-centimeter banner across the sheet.

report.overlay.insert_cf_in_rulers.label: Ruler scale bars
report.overlay.insert_cf_in_rulers.help: Lay a 1 cm and a 1 inch bar, drawn at the sheet's conversion factor, on a white raft over every detected ruler.

report.overlay.insert_cf_exterior.label: Exterior scale ring
report.overlay.insert_cf_exterior.help: Append a checkerboard of 1 cm squares outside the top and left edges of the sheet, so it measures without covering anything.

report.overlay.cf_scalebar.cm_color.label: 1 cm bar color
report.overlay.cf_scalebar.cm_color.help: Color of the centimeter bar in the ruler scale raft.

report.overlay.cf_scalebar.inch_color.label: 1 inch bar color
report.overlay.cf_scalebar.inch_color.help: Color of the inch bar in the ruler scale raft.

report.overlay.cf_scalebar.raft_color.label: Raft color
report.overlay.cf_scalebar.raft_color.help: Color of the solid backing the two ruler scale bars sit on.

report.overlay.cf_scalebar.brim.label: Raft brim
report.overlay.cf_scalebar.brim.help: Width in pixels of the backing that shows around and between the two bars.

report.overlay.cf_scalebar.bar_thickness.label: Bar thickness
report.overlay.cf_scalebar.bar_thickness.help: Bar width across the ruler in pixels at the reference resolution; it scales with image size and shrinks to fit a narrow ruler.

report.overlay.cf_scalebar.exterior_cell.label: Exterior ring thickness
report.overlay.cf_scalebar.exterior_cell.help: How many 1 cm squares thick the exterior checkerboard band is.

report.overlay.cf_scalebar.exterior_ligh.label: Exterior light square
report.overlay.cf_scalebar.exterior_ligh.help: Color of the light squares in the exterior checkerboard, and of the margin behind it.

report.overlay.cf_scalebar.exterior_dark.label: Exterior dark square
report.overlay.cf_scalebar.exterior_dark.help: Color of the dark squares in the exterior checkerboard.

report.overlay.groups.leaf.border.label: Leaf boxes: outline
report.overlay.groups.leaf.border.help: Stroke the outline of every box for Leaf_WHOLE and Leaf_PARTIAL.

report.overlay.groups.leaf.fill.label: Leaf boxes: fill
report.overlay.groups.leaf.fill.help: Shade the interior of every box for Leaf_WHOLE and Leaf_PARTIAL.

report.overlay.groups.leaf.fill_alpha.label: Leaf boxes: fill opacity
report.overlay.groups.leaf.fill_alpha.help: How opaque that interior shading is, 0 being invisible and 1 solid.

report.overlay.groups.leaf.line_width.label: Leaf boxes: line width
report.overlay.groups.leaf.line_width.help: Outline width in pixels at the reference resolution; it scales with image size.

report.overlay.groups.plant.border.label: Plant boxes: outline
report.overlay.groups.plant.border.help: Stroke the outline of every box for the other plant organ classes.

report.overlay.groups.plant.fill.label: Plant boxes: fill
report.overlay.groups.plant.fill.help: Shade the interior of every box for the other plant organ classes.

report.overlay.groups.plant.fill_alpha.label: Plant boxes: fill opacity
report.overlay.groups.plant.fill_alpha.help: How opaque that interior shading is, 0 being invisible and 1 solid.

report.overlay.groups.plant.line_width.label: Plant boxes: line width
report.overlay.groups.plant.line_width.help: Outline width in pixels at the reference resolution; it scales with image size.

report.overlay.groups.archival.border.label: Archival boxes: outline
report.overlay.groups.archival.border.help: Stroke the outline of every box for the archival classes such as rulers and labels.

report.overlay.groups.archival.fill.label: Archival boxes: fill
report.overlay.groups.archival.fill.help: Shade the interior of every box for the archival classes such as rulers and labels.

report.overlay.groups.archival.fill_alph.label: Archival boxes: fill opacity
report.overlay.groups.archival.fill_alph.help: How opaque that interior shading is, 0 being invisible and 1 solid.

report.overlay.groups.archival.line_widt.label: Archival boxes: line width
report.overlay.groups.archival.line_widt.help: Outline width in pixels at the reference resolution; it scales with image size.

report.overlay.alpha.label: Mask opacity
report.overlay.alpha.help: How opaque the mask fills are, 0 being clear and 1 solid.

report.overlay.line_width_mask.label: Mask outline width
report.overlay.line_width_mask.help: Width in pixels of the stroke around each mask.

report.overlay.font_scale.label: Label size
report.overlay.font_scale.help: Multiplier applied after labels are auto-fitted to their box.

report.overlay.label_text_color.label: Label text color
report.overlay.label_text_color.help: Color of the class-name text drawn inside each box.

report.overlay.cf_banner_color.label: CF banner color
report.overlay.cf_banner_color.help: Color of the conversion-factor banner text.

report.overlay.classes.archival.Ruler.sh.label: Ruler visible
report.overlay.classes.archival.Ruler.sh.help: Draw ruler on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.archival.Barcode..label: Barcode visible
report.overlay.classes.archival.Barcode..help: Draw barcode on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.archival.Colorcar.help: Draw color card on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.archival.Label.sh.help: Draw label on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.archival.Map.show.label: Map visible
report.overlay.classes.archival.Map.show.help: Draw map on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.archival.Envelope.help: Draw envelope on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.archival.Photo.sh.label: Photo visible
report.overlay.classes.archival.Photo.sh.help: Draw photo on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.archival.Attached.label: Attached item visible
report.overlay.classes.archival.Attached.help: Draw attached item on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.archival.Weights..label: Weights visible
report.overlay.classes.archival.Weights..help: Draw weights on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.plant.Leaf_WHOLE..label: Whole leaf visible
report.overlay.classes.plant.Leaf_WHOLE..help: Draw whole leaf on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.plant.Leaf_PARTIA.help: Draw partial leaf on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.plant.Leaflet.sho.help: Draw leaflet on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.plant.Seed_Fruit_.help: Draw single fruit on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.plant.Seed_Fruit_.help: Draw fruit cluster on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.plant.Flower_ONE..help: Draw single flower on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.plant.Flower_MANY.help: Draw flower cluster on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.plant.Bud.show.help: Draw bud on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.plant.Wood.show.help: Draw wood on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.segmentation.Leaf.help: Draw leaf mask on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.segmentation.Peti.help: Draw petiole mask on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.classes.segmentation.Hole.label: Hole mask visible
report.overlay.classes.segmentation.Hole.help: Draw hole mask on the overlay at all.

report.overlay.landmark.draw_points.label: Draw points
report.overlay.landmark.draw_points.help: Draw a dot at every keypoint.

report.overlay.landmark.draw_skeleton.label: Draw skeleton
report.overlay.landmark.draw_skeleton.help: Connect the keypoints with the skeleton lines.

report.overlay.landmark.min_conf.label: Hide below confidence
report.overlay.landmark.min_conf.help: Keypoints scoring under this are left undrawn as occluded or uncertain.

report.overlay.landmark.label_color.label: Landmark label color
report.overlay.landmark.label_color.help: Color of the text drawn beside the landmarks.

report.overlay.landmark.curvature_color.label: Curvature line color
report.overlay.landmark.curvature_color.help: Color of the two bend lines from the midvein ends to the curvature point.

report.overlay.landmark.colors.lamina.label: Lamina color
report.overlay.landmark.colors.lamina.help: Color used for the lamina tip and base anchor points.

report.overlay.landmark.colors.midvein.label: Midvein color
report.overlay.landmark.colors.midvein.help: Color used for the midrib trace.

report.overlay.landmark.colors.apex.label: Apex color
report.overlay.landmark.colors.apex.help: Color used for the apex triple.

report.overlay.landmark.colors.base.label: Base color
report.overlay.landmark.colors.base.help: Color used for the base triple.

report.overlay.landmark.colors.petiole.label: Petiole color
report.overlay.landmark.colors.petiole.help: Color used for the petiole trace and its tip.

report.overlay.landmark.colors.width.label: Width color
report.overlay.landmark.colors.width.help: Color used for the left and right width points.

report.overlay.petiole.width_color.label: Reported width color
report.overlay.petiole.width_color.help: Color of the reported median width band and the matching line in the zoom panel.

report.overlay.petiole.sample_color.label: Sample probe color
report.overlay.petiole.sample_color.help: Color of the individual perpendicular width probes.

report.overlay.petiole.band_thickness.label: Width band thickness
report.overlay.petiole.band_thickness.help: Thickness in pixels of the reported width band.

report.overlay.petiole.sample_thickness.label: Probe thickness
report.overlay.petiole.sample_thickness.help: Thickness in pixels of each sample probe.

report.overlay.petiole.mask_alpha.label: Mask opacity
report.overlay.petiole.mask_alpha.help: How opaque the leaf and petiole fills are in the petiole overlay.

report.overlay.petiole.label_color.label: Panel text color
report.overlay.petiole.label_color.help: Color of the measurement text in the petiole overlay panel.

report.overlay.petiole.zoom_bg_tint.label: Zoom tint amount
report.overlay.petiole.zoom_bg_tint.help: How strongly the zoom panel's background is tinted, 0 leaving the petiole in full color.

report.overlay.petiole.zoom_bg_color.label: Zoom tint color
report.overlay.petiole.zoom_bg_color.help: Color used for that zoom-panel background tint.

report.overlay_landmarks.enabled.label: Write landmark overlays
report.overlay_landmarks.enabled.help: Save one review image per leaf with its keypoints, skeleton, and derived measurements.

report.overlay_petiole.enabled.label: Write petiole overlays
report.overlay_petiole.enabled.help: Save one review image per leaf with a petiole, including the rotated close-up of the measured width.

report.overlay_specimen.enabled.label: Write specimen overlays
report.overlay_specimen.enabled.help: Save the two-panel review image showing the specimen mask on the sheet beside the cutout.

report.overlay_specimen.mask_color.label: Mask color
report.overlay_specimen.mask_color.help: Fill color of the final specimen mask.

report.overlay_specimen.refined_color.label: Removed-region color
report.overlay_specimen.refined_color.help: Tint marking the region the paper cleanup removed.

report.overlay_specimen.sample_box_color.label: Sample box color
report.overlay_specimen.sample_box_color.help: Outline color of the boxes showing where paper was sampled.

report.overlay_specimen.mask_alpha.label: Mask opacity
report.overlay_specimen.mask_alpha.help: How opaque the specimen mask fill is.

report.overlay_specimen.refined_alpha.label: Removed-region opacity
report.overlay_specimen.refined_alpha.help: How opaque the removed-region tint is.

report.overlay_specimen.outline.label: Stroke mask contour
report.overlay_specimen.outline.help: Draw a stroke along the final mask's contour.

report.overlay_specimen.display_max_dim.label: Panel max dimension
report.overlay_specimen.display_max_dim.help: Long-side pixel cap on each panel; 0 keeps full resolution.

report.overlay_ruler_lattice.enabled.label: Write ruler audit panels
report.overlay_ruler_lattice.enabled.help: Save the stacked panel per sheet showing every ruler's detected tick lattice and how they were reconciled into one conversion factor.

report.masks.classes.label: Exported classes
report.masks.classes.help: Which segmentation classes get a mask folder written.

report.masks.background.label: Background
report.masks.background.help: Background color behind the RGB cutouts.

report.masks.subtract_holes.label: Subtract holes
report.masks.subtract_holes.help: Remove the insect holes from the leaf mask instead of leaving the silhouette solid.

report.masks.Binary_Masks_Full_Image.label: Full-sheet binary masks
report.masks.Binary_Masks_Full_Image.help: Write one whole-sheet black-and-white leaf mask per specimen.

report.masks.RGB_Masks_Full_Image.label: Full-sheet color cutouts
report.masks.RGB_Masks_Full_Image.help: Write one whole-sheet color leaf cutout per specimen.

report.masks.Binary_Masks__Specimen.label: Specimen binary masks
report.masks.Binary_Masks__Specimen.help: Write the whole-plant black-and-white mask from the Specimen Segmenter.

report.masks.RGB_Masks__Specimen.label: Specimen color cutouts
report.masks.RGB_Masks__Specimen.help: Write the whole-plant color cutout on the chosen background.

report.masks.Binary_Masks__Specimen_Inve.label: Not-specimen binary masks
report.masks.Binary_Masks__Specimen_Inve.help: Write the exact inverse of the whole-plant mask: white everywhere the sheet is not plant.

report.masks.RGB_Masks__Specimen_Inverse.label: Not-specimen color cutouts
report.masks.RGB_Masks__Specimen_Inverse.help: Write the sheet with the plant lifted off it and painted over with the fill color below.

report.masks.inverse_fill.label: Not-specimen fill color
report.masks.inverse_fill.help: What replaces the plant in the not-specimen cutouts: white, black, or an r,g,b triple such as 255, 0, 0.

report.masks.Binary_Masks.label: Per-crop binary masks (legacy)
report.masks.Binary_Masks.help: Write the old unfitted per-crop leaf masks, superseded by the leaf products below.

report.masks.RGB_Masks.label: Per-crop color cutouts (legacy)
report.masks.RGB_Masks.help: Write the old unfitted per-crop leaf cutouts, superseded by the leaf products below.

report.crops.enabled.label: Write class crops
report.crops.enabled.help: Save the plain bounding-box crop of each detection into one folder per class; leaf crops are handled by the leaf products instead.

report.crops.classes.label: Cropped classes
report.crops.classes.help: 'all' crops every detected class, or list the class names you want, such as [Ruler, Label].

report.leaf_products.enabled.label: Write leaf products
report.leaf_products.enabled.help: Save the per-leaf product tree, the main measurable output of a run.

report.leaf_products.original.label: Original orientation
report.leaf_products.original.help: Write the tree that keeps each leaf as it sat on the sheet.

report.leaf_products.oriented.label: Upright orientation
report.leaf_products.oriented.help: Write the tree with each leaf rotated tip-up, which needs the Leaf Orientation module to have found a rotation.

report.leaf_products.background.label: Background
report.leaf_products.background.help: Color behind each cutout and in the corners left by rotation.

report.leaf_products.fit_pad.label: Fit padding (px)
report.leaf_products.fit_pad.help: Pixels of margin left around the fitted content; 0 crops tight.

report.leaf_products.hole_rgb_color.label: Hole fill color
report.leaf_products.hole_rgb_color.help: Color painted into the holes of the holes cutout so they can be thresholded later.

report.leaf_products.products.bbox.label: Bounding-box crop
report.leaf_products.products.bbox.help: Write the plain unfitted leaf crop for every leaf.

report.leaf_products.products.lamina_mas.label: Lamina mask
report.leaf_products.products.lamina_mas.help: Write the black-and-white lamina with holes removed for every leaf.

report.leaf_products.products.lamina_pet.label: Lamina + petiole mask
report.leaf_products.products.lamina_pet.help: Write the black-and-white lamina with its petiole for every leaf.

report.leaf_products.products.lamina_hol.label: Lamina silhouette mask
report.leaf_products.products.lamina_hol.help: Write the solid black-and-white lamina with holes filled for every leaf.

report.leaf_products.products.lamina_rgb.label: Lamina cutout
report.leaf_products.products.lamina_rgb.help: Write the color lamina cutout for every leaf.

report.leaf_products.products.lamina_pet.label: Lamina + petiole cutout
report.leaf_products.products.lamina_pet.help: Write the color lamina and petiole cutout for every leaf.

report.leaf_products.products.lamina_hol.label: Lamina holes cutout
report.leaf_products.products.lamina_hol.help: Write the color lamina cutout with its holes painted in for every leaf.

report.formats.jpg_quality.label: JPEG quality
report.formats.jpg_quality.help: Quality of the JPEG exports, 100 being visually lossless.

report.formats.mask_ext.label: Mask format
report.formats.mask_ext.help: Container for every black-and-white mask export; keep it lossless.

report.data.enabled.label: Write CSV data export
report.data.enabled.help: Write the project database out as CSV files into reports/Data at the end of the run. This is the numeric result of the run: the measurements behind every image LM3 produced.

report.data.folder.label: Folder name
report.data.folder.help: Subfolder of reports/ the CSV bundle is written into.

report.data.na_rep.label: Empty value
report.data.na_rep.help: What a missing measurement is written as. Blank is safest: most tools read it as a true missing value rather than as text. A measurement is missing when the pipeline could not make it (an occluded keypoint, or no conversion factor), never because it was zero.

report.data.float_precision.label: Decimal places
report.data.float_precision.help: Decimal places every number is rounded to, which keeps floating-point noise out of the files.

report.data.files.leaf_measurements.label: Leaf measurements
report.data.files.leaf_measurements.help: leaf_measurements.csv: ONE ROW PER LEAF, carrying every morphology, landmark, petiole and symmetry measurement together with the metadata that identifies the specimen and the leaf. The main file.

report.data.files.specimen_summary.label: Specimen summary
report.data.files.specimen_summary.help: specimen_summary.csv: one row per input image, with its conversion factor, phenology and counts and medians rolled up from that sheet's leaves.

report.data.files.phenology.label: Phenology (LM2 layout)
report.data.files.phenology.help: phenology.csv: one row per sheet in LeafMachine2's phenology.csv layout — per-class plant-organ counts plus has_leaves and is_fertile — so an existing LM2 phenology script reads it unchanged. Its 'leaflet' and 'specimen' columns are always blank, because LM3's detector has no such classes.

report.data.files.detections.label: Detections
report.data.files.detections.help: detections.csv: one row per detection box from both detectors, including the boxes that were suppressed as duplicates.

report.data.files.landmarks.label: Landmark keypoints
report.data.files.landmarks.help: landmarks.csv: one row per predicted keypoint, 31 per leaf, in both sheet and crop coordinates. The measurements derived from these are already in the leaf file.

report.data.files.ruler_conversion_facto.label: Ruler conversion factor
report.data.files.ruler_conversion_facto.help: ruler_conversion_factor.csv: one row per sheet recording the conversion-factor verdict, its confidence and the reasoning. Worth keeping: a wrong factor silently corrupts every centimeter value.

report.data.files.ruler_crops.label: Ruler crops
report.data.files.ruler_crops.help: ruler_crops.csv: one row per candidate ruler crop, including the ones skipped or unreadable.

report.data.files.run_stages.label: Run stages
report.data.files.run_stages.help: run_stages.csv: one row per pipeline stage with its state and counts.

report.data.files.stage_errors.label: Stage errors
report.data.files.stage_errors.help: stage_errors.csv: one row per per-image failure, so a run's errors are visible without opening the log.

report.data.files.data_dictionary.label: Data dictionary
report.data.files.data_dictionary.help: data_dictionary.csv: every column of every exported file, with its units and what it means.

report.leaf_products.products.lamina_pet.label: Lamina + petiole, holes filled
report.leaf_products.products.lamina_pet.help: Solid leaf-and-petiole silhouette with any holes filled in. Off by default; the ECT module turns it on automatically when it needs this mask.

timing.enabled.label: Enabled
timing.enabled.help: Time every module and write reports/Timing/timing.csv plus an interactive timing.html.

timing.sample_interval_s.label: Sample interval (s)
timing.sample_interval_s.help: How often processor and GPU utilization are sampled while modules run.
